title: A Quiet Sentence
rationale: An editable sentence replaces the conventional setup form. A single prominent action is all that remains once the defaults are right.
strength: The least visual work before a familiar session; duration and block list stay visible in plain language.
tradeoff: Inline selections can be less discoverable than labeled form rows.

title: Time First
rationale: Duration is the main object. Starting a session changes that same object into a countdown, preserving spatial continuity.
strength: Exceptionally clear active state and a small interaction footprint.
tradeoff: The large time field can outweigh the importance of reviewing blocked apps.

title: Three Rows
rationale: A compact native-style group summarizes what, how long, and the session rules. Only one toolbar action is prominent.
strength: Familiar, explicit, easy to implement with native Form and LabeledContent.
tradeoff: Functional and plain; less emotionally calm than the sentence approach.

title: Quiet Inspector
rationale: Move preparation to a persistent side inspector while the central surface is reserved for the current session.
strength: Good for people who change options often; keeps active session visually stable.
tradeoff: A permanent inspector adds structure and consumes width for a simple task.

title: Saved Rhythms
rationale: Choose a familiar duration-and-list recipe from a short list. The detail is a single review rather than a form.
strength: Fast repeat sessions with clear names and no bank of duration buttons.
tradeoff: Adds a preset concept that Zone does not currently need; may complicate first use.

title: The Focus Line
rationale: A keyboard-friendly composer accepts a duration, then exposes only its interpreted result and one start action.
strength: Fast for frequent keyboard users, with natural-language intent and minimal chrome.
tradeoff: Natural-language parsing introduces an unnecessary mental model and ambiguity.

title: Today, Gently
rationale: Place spontaneous focus among the day’s scheduled sessions. Now is a single actionable timeline item.
strength: Makes recurring sessions understandable without opening a separate calendar.
tradeoff: Schedule-first hierarchy distracts people who mainly use one-off sessions.

title: The Small Window
rationale: Treat the menu-bar panel as the entire everyday product: two setup rows, a quiet rule summary, and one primary action.
strength: Best fit for a menu-bar utility. Maps cleanly to a 320px native popover.
tradeoff: List and schedule editing still need a larger supporting window.
